name: Telecom Electronics
intro: Your trusted partner for advanced security and surveillance solutions. We specialize in CCTV systems, access control, fire safety, networking, control room integration, biometric systems, public address systems, and complete security infrastructure for homes, businesses, industries, and institutions. From consultation and installation to maintenance and upgrades, we deliver reliable, scalable, and modern security solutions tailored to your needs.
shortIntro: Providing smart CCTV, security, networking, and access control solutions with professional installation, maintenance, and support for homes and businesses.
